name: The Rested
flavor: Though waves may break, my ship shall take me off to the Land of Nod.
power: All Dreamers Draw from the Psyche Discard, or Refresh: put 1 Psyche on the deck bottom and Draw 1.

name: The Visionary
flavor: Peer deep enough within yourself and you will find the seed of everything.
power: Reveal Dreamers+1 Landscapes, or each Dreamer Peeks at 1 deck top and may send it to the bottom.

name: The Runner
flavor: Nothing's faster than thought, and I *am* thought.
power: All Dreamers Move 2 spaces toward or away from The Bed / Final Recurrence.

name: The Hunter
flavor: No Prey can escape my chase.
power: Move each active Dreambeast 1 space toward the nearest Dreamer or away from The Bed.

name: The Immovable
flavor: Even Time stands still for those who wait long enough.
power: Hold the Line: during the next Meet Phase, all Dreamers may add +1 Psyche to any Accept or Reject spread.

name: The Weaver
flavor: Strands of fate, woven as I will it.
power: Threads of Will: each Dreamer Discards 1 Psyche and Draws 1.
